Name: Minecraft project
Description: Build, deploy, launch, and maintain a Minecraft Spigot server using Docker Compose.

Children.Name: Build Version 26.3
Children.Description: Build the Spigot 26.3 JAR using Java 25 and Docker Compose.
Children.Command: JAVA_VERSION=25 MC_VERSION=26.3 docker compose -f build/compose.yml run --build --rm builder

Children.Name: Deploy Server 26.3
Children.Description: Prepare the server directory, accept the Minecraft EULA, and copy the built Spigot JAR.

Children.Name: Launch Server 26.3
Children.Description: Start Spigot interactively using the server Compose file and published ports.
Children.Command: JAVA_VERSION=25 MC_VERSION=26.3 docker compose -f server/compose.yml run --rm --service-ports spigot

Children.Name: Chown Servers
Children.Description: Give chriss ownership of the Minecraft server directory and its contents.

Children.Name: Set SSH Docker Config
Children.Description: Set Docker's alternate config directory for this command's shell only; it will not persist in your original terminal.

Children.Name: Cleanup Build Versions
Children.Description: Permanently delete all generated versions under build/versions after confirmation, keeping the parent directory.
Command: read -r -p 'Delete all built Minecraft versions? [y/N] ' confirm &&

Children.Name: Cleanup Server Versions
Children.Description: Permanently delete all deployed server versions, worlds, and configuration under server/versions after confirmation.
Command: read -r -p 'Delete ALL deployed Minecraft servers and worlds? [y/N] ' confirm &&
